subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` passthrough, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or no user-configurable beta flags?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but adding a provider request-field contract expands user-facing config surface and repository policy treats provider routing and config additions as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
options.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without creating a core-generic passthrough.

options.title: Add only a typed beta option
options.body: Support a narrower Bedrock `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` path for Claude long context while avoiding arbitrary Converse body injection.

options.title: Decline custom betas
options.body: Keep Bedrock request shaping internal and ask users to wait for first-class provider support for each beta feature.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned request fields
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock plugin or per-model params contract that safely merges request fields, validates shape, documents upgrade behavior, and covers `anthropic_beta` without creating a core-generic passthrough.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main owner signal for the central Bedrock request construction and option contract lines.
